apps.name: OpenNOW Debug
apps.localizedDescription: Adds Apple MetalFX spatial upscaling with high-precision HDR processing and separate experimental 60-to-120 FPS video interpolation. Both default off. Frame generation checks device/format support, never converts 4:4:4 HDR to 8-bit/4:2:0, and pauses for heat, power or missed deadlines. HDR/4:4:4 interpolation remains unverified on iPhone/iPad. Strict hardware 4:4:4 HDR and prior fixes retained. Device build, 176 simulator tests and separate Mac GPU checks passed; one MetalFX simulator skip.
